name: How long does it typically take to replace a kitchen sink and faucet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to replace a kitchen sink and faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen sink and faucet replacement typically takes between two and four hours if the layout and plumbing lines remain the same. The timeframe can extend to a full day or require multi-phase coordination if your project involves custom countertop modifications, converting from a drop-in to an undermount sink, or rerouting supply and drain lines. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra coordinates the project directly, ensuring any necessary plumbing trade partners are scheduled seamlessly alongside custom carpentry or countertop adjustments so your kitchen remains out of commission for as short a window as possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: A direct replacement usually takes two to four hours. Custom countertop cuts, plumbing relocations, or cabinetry adjustments can extend the project to a full day or more.
